provenance: Identical-template synthetic stress check. The assessment's eligible synthetic seed tickets are repeated with unique IDs. This is not a production benchmark or an estimate of performance on a real corpus.

scope.default_volume_rationale: 55,000 is a rounded one-year planning assumption at 150 incoming tickets per day; here all replicated records are treated as eligible resolved history.

timing.index_build_scope: SearchEngine construction, including validation and tokenization; excludes disk reads and fixture replication.
timing.search_scope: Warm sequential in-process search. Includes ranking and result construction; excludes HTTP, concurrency, process startup and network. p95 uses the nearest-rank method.

limitations: Identical text repetition changes term frequencies and posting-list lengths artificially; it does not represent vocabulary diversity or real relevance.
Only the supplied NT-1, NT-2 and NT-3 queries are exercised; this is a performance stress check, not retrieval-quality evaluation. Some queries can correctly produce no suggestion.
Single local process, sequential requests, one timing run; no production latency, throughput, availability or memory claim.
